verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents automating the tailnet through infrastructure-as-code providers, and it has an editable tailnet policy file. That implies automation and config can be kept in external version control, reviewed, and rolled back, but only through outside tooling, and none of this is documented. Missing for 10: native version history for automations or policies, a built-in review/approval workflow, a documented rollback mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
